description: Digital logic simulator: draggable gates/flip-flops/adders, interactive wires, state propagation, single-step, truth tables + timing diagram, save/load, examples. No libraries.

criteria: circuitsmith.html is one self-contained digital logic simulator (no libraries): a visual editor with draggable components (switch, clock, NOT/AND/NAND/OR/NOR/XOR/XNOR, LED, flip-flops, adders, multiplexer), interactive wires with pan/zoom/snap, state propagation over 0/1/undefined with feedback handling, single-cycle stepping, truth-table generation and a timing diagram, plus save/load and example circuits. No fake or hardcoded states.
